name: What does black mold on drywall look like?

mainEntity.name: What does black mold on drywall look like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Black mold on drywall often appears as dark green or black spots, usually with a fuzzy or slimy texture. It can sometimes have a patchy or speckled appearance. Mold growth on drywall may also cause discoloration, staining, or bubbling of the paint or wallpaper. Beyond visual cues, a persistent musty or earthy odor is a common indicator of mold presence, even if the mold itself is not immediately visible.
acceptedAnswer.description: Black mold on drywall typically looks like dark green or black spots with a fuzzy or slimy texture, often accompanied by a musty odor.
